title: Lender provides £490k for two-flat scheme in Anerley
summary:
Assetz Capital has provided a development finance facility of £490,000 for the construction of two residential flats in Anerley, South London. The 15-month loan, structured at 70% loan-to-value, will fund two one-bedroom garden flats near Crystal Palace Park.

title: Landlords increasingly turn to agents amid regulatory complexity
summary:
Two-thirds of landlords in the UK now use lettings agents for some or all aspects of property management, marking the highest level of agent engagement in two years. The proportion has risen from 61% in the first quarter, with demand for full property management services driving the increase.

title: Dwelly acquires Kent agency in eleventh deal of 2026
summary:
Property management firm Dwelly has acquired Kent-based Helen Breeze Property Management, adding 400 fully managed properties to its portfolio. The transaction marks Dwelly's eleventh acquisition in 2026, bringing its total portfolio to approximately 15,665 properties under management.

title: UK rental prices reach new highs as supply falls
summary:
Average advertised rents outside London have reached £1,418 per calendar month, marking a new record, according to data from property portal Rightmove. The figures show asking rent prices increased by 1.5% this quarter, though annual rental growth has moderated to 2.4%.

title: Norfolk letting agent sentenced for £48,000 fraud
summary:
A Norfolk letting agent has been sentenced for fraud offences totalling £48,858 against landlords and tenants. Victoria Steele received a 12-month suspended sentence after admitting to 19 offences involving failures to protect deposits and pass on rental payments.

title: Half of UK family homes now affordable on average income
summary:
More than half of two and three-bedroom houses for sale in the UK are now within reach of households earning the average income, according to research from Zoopla. The property portal found that 51% of family homes are listed with an asking price below £301,000, up from 45% a year ago.

title: Under-45s view home ownership as essential, study finds
summary:
Younger generations continue to prioritise home ownership despite affordability challenges, with 84% of under-45s considering it essential. New research from LRG shows deposit barriers remain the primary obstacle rather than lack of desire to buy.

title: Second charge bridge rescues landlords from arrears
summary:
Specialist lender Somo has completed a £145,000 second charge bridging loan to help two portfolio landlords clear mortgage arrears and remove a title restriction. The 18-month facility was secured against a property valued at £460,000 with an existing £65,000 first charge, allowing the borrowers time to sell assets without pressure.

title: Maslow Capital provides £238m for Southwark student scheme
summary:
Maslow Capital has provided a £238 million development finance facility to a joint venture between Arada London and the Shaw Corporation for a mixed-use scheme in Southwark. The facility will fund Devonshire Place, comprising 941 purpose-built student accommodation beds and 200 affordable homes on the Old Kent Road.
